args.role: Test whether itch.io can sell an existing downloadable technical exercise. Verify seller eligibility, collection and package execution, and prepare a private listing only when supported by evidence.

description: Closed the bounded UK Contracts Finder screen and verified the saved verdict. The official feed and search page surfaced no qualifying buyer brief, and one follow-up returned HTTP 404. That leaves no basis for a quote from this screen. Reopen it when a readable current notice specifies separately quotable paid work, acceptance criteria, supplier eligibility and a response route. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 verified available and no verified revenue. The next experiment tests a separate checkout route for the existing SQLite exercise using public sources and offline tools.
